guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails at the step installing python3.11 and related packages from the deadsnakes PPA on Ubuntu 20.04. The error is: "E: Unable to locate package python3.11" and similarly for python3.11-venv and python3.11-distutils. The deadsnakes PPA does not provide Python 3.11 packages for Ubuntu 20.04 (focal), only for newer Ubuntu versions such as 22.04 and later. This causes the apt install command to fail and the build to abort. To fix this, either update the base image to ubuntu:22.04 or newer (which supports python3.11 via deadsnakes PPA or natively), or change the Python version to one supported on Ubuntu 20.04 by the PPA (e.g., python3.10). Alternatively, if python3.11 is mandatory, base image must be upgraded. Adjust all related apt package names accordingly. Include installation of build dependencies and pip upgrades as needed for the chosen Python version.
